outcome: Small for Gestational Age (SGA)/Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR)
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies who were enrolled during their second trimester.
finding: Abnormal antenatal umbilical coiling index (hypocoiled or hypercoiled) is associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes.
followup_time: until delivery and immediate neonatal period
